content.text: You're a digital creator in Zimbabwe, where PayPal and Stripe are blocked, and Gumroad's 10% fees are crippling your ebook sales. You need a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-2|The Full]] that lets you accept Bitcoin, process orders, and deliver [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-7|ebooks]] without relying on platforms that can freeze your funds. This guide shows you how to set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-live-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] and delivery pipeline that's yours to control, without breaking the bank or sacrificing features.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like PayPal and Stripe may work for some, but they're restrictive and expensive for those in countries with stringent regulations or payment restrictions. That's why a sovereign infrastructure like the one we're about to deploy is essential for digital creators who want to stay in control and keep their profits intact. By using a combination of free and paid tools, you can create a payment and delivery pipeline that's entirely yours to manage, without relying on middlemen that take a cut of your earnings.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign infrastructure, you'll need to sign up for the required tools and accounts. These include a GitHub Pages account for hosting, a Cloudflare account for DNS management, and a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency payment processing. You'll also need to purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all the blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your infrastructure. Once you have these tools and accounts set up, you'll be ready to move on to the next step in deploying your infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a GitHub Pages site and configure it to accept Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments. You'll also need to create a Cloudflare account and configure it to manage your DNS settings. Next, you'll need to set up a Supabase database to store your orders and a Google Drive account to deliver your ebooks. Finally, you'll need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline to work together seamlessly, so that when a customer makes a payment, their ebook is automatically delivered to their email address.
With this infrastructure, you'll never have to worry about platform fees or restrictions again.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you'll be ready to go live and start processing transactions. This involves activating your NOWPayments account, configuring your payment gateway, and setting up a test transaction to ensure everything is working correctly. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling your ebooks to customers around the world. Remember to keep your eyes on the dashboard and your fingers on the pulse, as your infrastructure will continue to evolve and improve over time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows and more customers start buying your ebooks, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This involves upgrading your hosting to a more robust plan, increasing your payment gateway limits, and optimizing your delivery pipeline to reduce latency and improve performance. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have all the tools and templates you need to scale your infrastructure and keep your business running smoothly, even as it grows.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
You'll be able to sell your ebooks to customers around the world without relying on middlemen.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more resources to help you build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to get started. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

Here's a step-by-step checklist to help you deploy your sovereign infrastructure: Sign up for a GitHub Pages account and create a new site Configure your Cloudflare account and set up DNS management Create a NOWPayments account and configure it to accept Bitcoin payments Set up a Supabase database to store your orders and a Google Drive account to deliver your ebooks Configure your payment and delivery pipeline to work together seamlessly Activate your NOWPayments account and configure your payment gateway Set up a test transaction to ensure everything is working correctly Go live and start processing transactions!
Frequently Asked Questions
What if I'm not technical and don't know how to set up a payment and delivery pipeline?

Don't worry, you don't need to be a coding expert to set up a sovereign infrastructure. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have access to all the blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your infrastructure, even if you're new to coding.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell other digital products besides ebooks?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell any type of digital product, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and plugins. The key is to configure your payment and delivery pipeline to work with the specific product you're selling.
How do I handle customer support and refunds with this infrastructure?

To handle customer support and refunds, you'll need to set up a support email address and configure your payment gateway to process refunds. You can also use a customer support tool like Zendesk or Freshdesk to manage your support requests and refunds.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell physical products?

No, this infrastructure is designed specifically for selling digital products. If you want to sell physical products, you'll need to use a different type of infrastructure, such as a fulfillment center or a shipping API.
How do I track my sales and analytics with this infrastructure?

To track your sales and analytics, you'll need to set up a Google Analytics account and configure it to track your website traffic and sales. You can also use a sales tracking tool like Mixpanel or Amplitude to track your sales and customer behavior.
By using a sovereign infrastructure, you'll be able to keep your profits intact and stay in control of your business.
